vision.name: Saiyan Surging Mastery
vision.text:
(You cannot win by MPPV.)
[Continuous]: Your Styled attacks gain "Raise your anger 1." At the start of the Discard Step, if your MP advanced a level this turn, lower your MP 1 level.
[Instant] POWER: Use when an effect lowers your MP 1 or more levels. Draw a card.
POWER: Your next attack this combat deals +X life cards. X = your MP's level.
